blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Saturday greeted Iglesia ni Cristo (INC) Executive Minister Eduardo Manalo on his 71st birthday, expressing support for their shared goal of a peaceful and united Philippines. “Maligayang kaarawan po kay Kapatid na Eduardo V. Manalo, Tagapamahalang Pangkalahatan ng Iglesia ni Cristo!” Marcos said in a Facebook post on his official page. (Happy birthday to Brother Eduardo V. Manalo, Executive Minister of the Iglesia ni Cristo!) “Nawa’y patuloy kayong pagkalooban ng Panginoong Diyos ng mabuting kalusugan, lakas, at karunungan sa inyong pamumuno at paglilingkod,” he added.
